themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Reviews about push or news alerts from the app, including whether they can be turned off or controlled in settings, how often they arrive, and whether they clear after being read.

themes.name: Streaming reliability
themes.description: Reviews about live and on-demand audio that buffers, drops, disconnects, fails to connect, or gives errors such as 'no audio available' or 'cannot play this media'. This includes interruptions from phone calls, notification sounds and switching between WiFi and mobile data.

themes.name: Playlist persistence
themes.description: Reviews about the playlist or queue: whether saved items are kept or deleted, how it is organized, edited or found, and how well it supports listening to whole programs.

themes.name: Audio skipping and cutoffs
themes.description: Reviews about audio that jumps forward or backward, starts a story partway through, repeats snippets, or cuts off before the end of a story or program.

themes.name: App crashes and freezing
themes.description: Reviews about the app force-closing, freezing, hanging, or becoming unresponsive. This includes crashes tied to specific actions such as opening photos, and complaints that the app is buggy in general.

themes.name: Station availability
themes.description: Reviews about whether particular local or regional stations and their streams are listed, searchable, or selectable. This includes stations that disappear, are missing from search or nearest lists, or show only podcasts instead of the live stream.

themes.name: Political bias and trust
themes.description: Reviews that judge NPR's fairness, objectivity, political slant, or trustworthiness as a news source, whether praising it as unbiased and honest or criticizing it as biased.

themes.name: Interface design and usability
themes.description: Reviews about the app's look, layout, navigation, and ease of use. This includes outdated design, Material Design requests, clutter, and clean, simple or intuitive design.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: Reviews about the app running in the background or at startup, battery and data consumption, playing or reopening on its own after being closed, and the lack of a way to exit or stop it.

themes.name: Program and podcast catalog
themes.description: Reviews about which shows and podcasts are available in the app, such as missing programs or episodes, a non-working programs tab, and content that is out of date or not updating.
